0.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANY_00046_FULKE_000_01
0.description: Greetings, friend. The Order of the Twin Adder welcomes any who would stand and fight in defense of Gridania.
0.translation_description: Salve, avventuriero. L'Ordine della Vipera Gemella accoglie chiunque sia disposto a combattere per difendere Gridania.

1.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANY_00046_FULKE_000_05
1.description: Private <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>, is it? As befits your current rank and station, you are limited to having 1,000 Serpent Seals on your person at any given time.
1.translation_description: Soldato <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>, dico bene? In base al tuo grado e al tuo incarico, puoi portare con te al massimo 1.000 sigilli della Vipera.

2.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANY_00046_FULKE_000_06
2.description: As you continue to serve and rise within our ranks, this limit will be increased.
2.translation_description: Man mano che continuerai a servire e a salire di grado, questo limite aumenterà.

3.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANY_00046_FULKE_000_07
3.description: However, at this time, we are not accepting any applications for promotions. Until our enlistment goals for this season are finalized, we cannot determine how many commissions will be necessary.
3.translation_description: Tuttavia, al momento non accettiamo richieste di promozione. Finché non avremo definito gli obiettivi di reclutamento della stagione, non potremo stabilire quante nomine saranno necessarie.

4.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANY_00046_SYSTEM_000_08
4.description: Grand Company rank promotions are not available in the Beta Version.
4.translation_description: Nella versione beta non è possibile ottenere promozioni di grado nelle Grandi Compagnie.

5.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANY_00046_FULKE_000_10
5.description: If it is glory that you seek, you will find much in service to our Order. I beseech you─add your strength to ours, and with us defend Gridania.
5.translation_description: Se cerchi la gloria, al servizio del nostro Ordine ne troverai in abbondanza. Te ne supplico: unisci la tua forza alla nostra e difendi Gridania insieme a noi.

6.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANY_00046_FULKE_000_15
6.description: Though we want for new recruits, you must needs first demonstrate commitment to our cause. Should you prove your loyalty to Gridania, we would gladly welcome you into our ranks.
6.translation_description: Anche se abbiamo bisogno di nuove reclute, prima devi dimostrare la tua dedizione alla nostra causa. Se dimostrerai la tua lealtà a Gridania, saremo lieti di accoglierti tra le nostre file.

7.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANY_00046_SYSTEM_000_16
7.description: To enlist in the Order of the Twin Adder in the Beta Version, you must first speak with the wandering minstrel standing outside the Adders' Nest.
7.translation_description: Nella versione beta, per arruolarti nell'Ordine della Vipera Gemella devi prima parlare con il menestrello errante che si trova fuori dal Nido delle Vipere.

8.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANY_00046_Q1_01
8.description: Enlist in the Order of the Twin Adder?
8.translation_description: Vuoi arruolarti nell'Ordine della Vipera Gemella?

11.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANY_00046_FULKE_000_20
11.description: Then I greet you as a <hex:020814E905FF07736973746572FF0862726F7468657203>! The annals of our time shall read that from this day forth, <hex:022903EB0203> was reborn a Serpent of the Order of the Twin Adder!
11.translation_description: Allora ti accolgo come <hex:020816E905FF08736F72656C6C61FF0966726174656C6C6F03>! Le cronache del nostro tempo racconteranno che da oggi <hex:022903EB0203> rinasce tra le file dell'Ordine della Vipera Gemella!

12.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANY_00046_FULKE_000_21
12.description: I bid you learn what you can from your fellow Serpents. Follow their example, observe and uphold our code, and carry out your tasks to the best of your ability.
12.translation_description: Ti invito a imparare dai tuoi compagni. Segui il loro esempio, osserva e rispetta il nostro codice e svolgi al meglio i tuoi compiti.

13.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANY_00046_FULKE_000_22
13.description: Know that we have great expectations of you, Private <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>.
13.translation_description: Sappi che ci aspettiamo grandi cose da te, soldato <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200303>.

14.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANY_00046_TALK_YESNO_NO
14.description: I had hoped that you would say otherwise. Very well. But know that our doors are always open to those who would serve and protect the Twelveswood.
14.translation_description: Speravo che rispondessi diversamente. E sia. Sappi però che le nostre porte sono sempre aperte a chi desidera servire e proteggere il Bosco dei Dodici.

15.name: TEXT_COMDEFGRANDCOMPANY_00046_TALK_YESNO_NO2
15.description: We will welcome you with open arms should you experience a change of heart.
15.translation_description: Ti accoglieremo a braccia aperte se dovessi cambiare idea.
